xmldoc.short_description: Correct error by converting to function notation.

param_input_item.param_description: method name that should be called using function notation.

description.p: Use nelson.lang.correction.ConvertToFunctionNotationCorrection objects in classes whose methods should not be called using dot notation.
correction = nelson.lang.correction.ConvertToFunctionNotationCorrection(method) creates a correction that suggests converting dot notation to function notation syntax for calling method.
The read-only Method property contains the method name.
